charts.title: Revenue of the health and fitness market in Europe from 2017 to 2022 (in billion euros)
charts.short: Value of the European health and fitness industry 2017-2022
charts.description: The health and fitness market in Europe was worth an estimated 28 billion U.S. dollars in 2022. This is a significant increase in the market size of just over 17 billion U.S. dollars in 2021. This can be attributed to the continued recovery of the industry following the impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, which forced the temporary closure of thousands of gyms and health clubs across Europe.

charts.title: Revenue of the fitness market in Germany from 2014 to 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Germany: revenue of the fitness market 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, the revenue of the fitness market stood at 4.9 billion euros. This marked an increase of more than 100 percent on the previous year, indicating the industry's recovery following the significant impact of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic.

charts.title: Number of gyms and health clubs in Europe from 2009 to 2022
charts.short: Number of health and fitness clubs in Europe 2009-2022
charts.description: The number of gyms and health clubs in Europe has generally been on the increase since 2009. While there was a slight dip in the number of establishments in 2020 as a result of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, the number of gyms in Europe increased again in 2022, reaching 63,830.

charts.title: Number of members at health and fitness clubs in Europe in 2022, by country (in millions)
charts.short: Gym membership in European countries 2022
charts.description: In 2022, there were approximately 10.4 million gym members in the United Kingdom. Meanwhile, there were around 5.4 million members at health clubs and fitness establishments in Spain.

charts.title: Number of fitness club members in Germany from 2014 to 2022 (in millions)
charts.short: Number of gym members in Germany 2014-2022
charts.description: In 2022, there were approximately 10.3 million fitness club members in Germany. This marked an increase of over one million on the gym membership figures from a year previous.

charts.title: Leading fitness club operators in Germany in 2022, by number of clubs
charts.short: Leading gym chains in Germany in 2022, by number of clubs
charts.description: In 2022, the largest fitness club operator in Germany was clever fit. Established in 2004, the franchise fitness chain grew to 450 gyms across the country, more than twice as many gyms as its closest competitor, RSG Group.
charts.note: Germany; 2022; * Fully or partly a franchise operation. Read more

charts.title: Leading sports types in Germany in 2023, by number of members (in millions)
charts.short: Sports popularity by members in Germany 2023
charts.description: This graph shows selected sports types by the number of participating members in Germany in 2023. That year, around 10.3 million people were registered in fitness studios, while more than seven million were members of soccer clubs.
charts.source: Deloitte; Deutsche Hochschule für Prävention und Gesundheitsmanagement; Deutscher Olympischer Sportbund Members in millions

charts.title: Number of people exercising or playing sports in Germany from 2017 to 2021, by frequency (in millions)
charts.short: Frequency of recreational exercising in Germany 2017-2021
charts.description: Germans usually opt for exercising several times a month or several times a week, based on this survey. And plenty never do so or prefer to keep their activities to themselves. In any case, gym and sports club memberships, home workouts, various outdoor activities, swimming, jogging and cycling are just a few examples of the ways in which the German population likes to stay fit and active.
charts.note: Germany; 2017 to 2021; 14 years and older; German-speaking population

charts.title: Share of young people exercising in Germany in 2021, by frequency
charts.short: Young people exercising in Germany 2021, by frequency
charts.description: In 2021, 27 percent of young people in Germany aged between 14 and 19 years exercised several times a month. Among 20 to 25-year-olds, 25.5 percent did the same. The figures are based on a survey conducted in Germany in 2021.
charts.note: Germany; 14 years and older; German-speaking population

charts.title: Value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to Germany from 2016 to 2022 (in 1,000 euros)
charts.short: Germany: articles and equipment for sports import value 2016-2022
charts.description: This statistic presents the value of articles and equipment for physical exercise, gymnastics, athletics and other sports imported to Germany from 2016 to 2022. In 2022, imports of sports equipment and articles including swimming pools and paddling pools amounted to approximately 2.2 billion euros.

charts.title: Which of these fitness or health services (website or app) have you used as a paying customer in the past 12 months?
charts.short: Online fitness and health service purchases by brand in Germany 2020
charts.description: The displayed data on online fitness and health service purchases by brand shows results of the Statista Global Consumer Survey conducted in Germany in 2020. Some 30 percent of respondents answered the question "Which of these fitness or health services (website or app) have you used as a paying customer in the past 12 months?" with "Gymondo".
charts.note: Germany; 22 Jul to 20 Aug 2020 and 17 Feb to 25 Mar 2020; 142 respondents; 18-64 years; respondents who spent money on online fitness & health services (websites and apps)
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents

charts.title: Leading health and fitness apps in the Google Play Store in Germany in September 2022, by number of downloads
charts.short: Leading Android health apps in Germany 2022, by downloads
charts.description: In September 2022, the Corona-Warn-App app was downloaded approximately 114 thousand times onto Android mobile devices in Germany, while the Samsung Health was downloaded approximately 86 thousand time. The Huawei Health app ranked fourth with 84.5 thousand downloads from the Google Play Store in Germany in the examined month.
charts.note: Germany; September 2022; based on downloads to devices in Germany.

charts.title: Most used eHealth tracker / smart watches by brand in Germany as of December 2023
charts.short: Most used eHealth tracker / smart watches by brand in Germany 2023
charts.description: With 35 percent, Apple is the most popular brand for personal smart watches and eHealth or fitness trackers among German consumers. In second place follows Samsung with 21 percent of respondents. These results are based on a representative online survey conducted in 2023 among 2,050 consumers in Germany.
charts.note: Germany; January to December 2023; 2050 respondents; 18-64 years; respondents who use fitness trackers, smartwatches with fitness function, motion trackers or sleep tracking systems (Housing & household equipment, Internet & devices)
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents

charts.title: Sales revenue of wearables in Germany from 2014 to 2023 (in million euros)
charts.short: Revenue from wearable sales in Germany 2014-2023
charts.description: In 2023, revenues from wearable sales in Germany amounted to roughly 1.45 billion euros. This was a decrease of around 100,000 euros compared with the previous year.

charts.title: Sales volume of wearables in Germany from 2015 to 2023 (in millions)
charts.short: Sales volume of wearables in Germany 2015-2023
charts.description: In 2023, roughly 5.88 million wearable devices were sold in Germany. This was a significant decrease compared to 2022, the sale of wearable devices has rapidly increased since 2015 in which only 2.02 million devices were sold and peaked in 2021.
charts.note: Germany; 2015 to 2023; Core wearables, private demand

charts.title: Online revenue forecast for the eServices market by segment in Germany from 2023 to 2030 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue forecast for the eServices market by segment in Germany until 2030
charts.description: The revenue is forecast to experience significant growth in all segments in 2030. Comparing the three different segments for the year 2030, the segment 'Event Tickets' leads the ranking with 3.5 million U.S. dollars. Contrastingly, 'Dating Services' is ranked last, with 305.52 million U.S. dollars. Their difference, compared to Event Tickets, lies at 3.2 million U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Forecast for the average revenue per online user for the eServices market by segment in Germany from 2021 to 2028 (in U.S. dollars)

charts.description: Significant fluctuations are estimated for all segments over the forecast period for the average revenue per user. Only for the segment Event Tickets, a significant increase can be observed over the forecast period. Here, the indicator exhibits a difference of 18.05 U.S. dollars between 2021 and 2028.
